div.div:
The dependency rule, and why it holds
Models knows nothing about Core or Infrastructure — which is what lets
ProjectItem consume a render's results (ProcessingSliceRecord,
AppliedCanvasProfile) without depending on anything image-processing.
The pipeline never touches ProjectItem, Workspace or a serializer: it takes
a copy of the input list and returns records the caller applies. That is what
makes it safe to run on a worker thread while the GUI holds the workspace.
